Each Financial Planning Consultant will be accredited with their Certified Financial Planning designation (CFP) with Financial Planning Canada and in Quebec the (IQPF) designation.

 The CAD team works with CAD engineers and RFIC designers to turn AI-assisted layout ideas into practical tools for engineering design. The work focuses on building and evaluating prototypes such as DRC-clean parameterized layout generators or surrogate models that predict layout results without a full verification run. The role emphasizes careful data preparation, evaluation against designer-created layouts, and delivery of code and written evaluation that the team can continue to use.
 How you will make an impact: 
 Prototype machine learning and optimization methods for placement, routing and layout synthesis of RFIC and analog blocks.
 Build layout generators, including parameterized cells (PCells), that follow geometry, topology and foundry design rules.
 Build surrogate models and design-space-exploration frameworks so designers can compare options without running every candidate through the full flow.
 Own the data pipeline end to end, including generating layout datasets, training models and measuring the results.
 Write well-tested software components in Python and C++.
 Test results on real design problems with RFIC designers and CAD engineers, and report clearly where AI helps and where it does not.
 The must haves: 
 Education: Actively enrolled in a Master’s or PhD program in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, EDA/CAD, Applied Mathematics or a related field,
 A Python project you built, such as research code, a course project or an open-source contribution, that you can walk us through.
 Experience training and evaluating at least one model with PyTorch, TensorFlow or scikit-learn.
 Coursework or project experience with data structures, algorithms and object-oriented programming.
 Interest in applying AI and machine learning to engineering design automation.
 Nice to haves: 
 Experience with C++.
 Experience with Cadence Virtuoso, SKILL or PCell development.
 Coursework or project experience in analog/RF IC design or layout, including DRC and LVS.
 Experience with graph neural networks or reinforcement learning.
 Coursework or project experience in computational geometry.
 Development experience with Git and Linux.

 Titre du poste: Architecte principal national
 À propos de Pratt & Whitney Canada 
 Pratt & Whitney Canada (P&WC) est un leader mondial de l’innovation aérospatiale, dont le siège social est situé à Longueuil, au Québec, depuis 1928. Nous concevons et fabriquons des moteurs d’aéronefs de nouvelle génération qui propulsent la plus grande flotte mondiale d’avions et d’hélicoptères dans les segments de l’aviation d’affaires, de l’aviation générale et de l’aviation régionale.
 Depuis près de 100 ans, nos équipes sont à l’avant-garde des technologies de propulsion, repoussant les limites afin de rendre nos moteurs plus performants et fiables. Nos moteurs soutiennent des missions essentielles, du transport de passagers et de marchandises aux services médicaux d’urgence, aux opérations humanitaires et à la lutte contre les feux de forêt, partout dans le monde.
 Un employeur de choix 
 Pratt & Whitney Canada a été reconnue comme l’un des meilleurs employeurs au Canada en 2026 selon Forbes, et ce, pour une 11e année consécutive. L’entreprise s’est également classée au premier rang des employeurs de l’industrie de l’aérospatiale et de la défense au pays. De plus, notre siège social figure toujours parmi les meilleurs employeurs de la région de Montréal. Ensemble, ces distinctions confirment notre réputation d’employeur de choix à Montréal, au Canada et à l’échelle mondiale.
 Pourquoi rejoindre notre équipe? 
 Pratt & Whitney transforme l’avenir de l’aviation en concevant, en fabriquant et en assurant l’entretien de moteurs sans pareil dans le monde. Cette transformation repose sur de solides fondations en architecture d’entreprise. Nous sommes donc à la recherche d’un architecte principal national pour le Canada, expérimenté, méthodique et visionnaire, qui contribuera à façonner notre avenir numérique et technologique.
 Venez explorer de nouvelles possibilités et découvrez un environnement où votre talent prend son envol, bien au-delà des limites d’un titre, d’un pays ou de votre zone de confort. Apportez votre passion et votre engagement, et vous rejoindrez une équipe soudée qui prend sa mission à cœur. Mettez votre volonté de faire une différence au service d’une organisation et d’une industrie qui évoluent rapidement pour façonner l’avenir. 
 L’innovation grâce à la diversité des points de vue. Chez Pratt & Whitney, nous croyons que la diversité des points de vue favorise la créativité et l’innovation, tout en jetant les bases d’une culture inclusive. En cultivant un milieu de travail inclusif, nous assumons collectivement la responsabilité de reconnaître, de soutenir, d’accompagner, de recruter et de promouvoir les talents de manière équitable. Nous encourageons chaque membre de notre personnel à être pleinement soi-même et à donner le meilleur de soi-même au travail, car la confiance, le respect et l’intégrité font partie intégrante de notre ADN.
 Le poste s’effectue à notre établissement de Longueuil , du lundi au vendredi, selon des horaires flexibles et exclusivement en présentiel.
 À quoi ressemblera votre quotidien? 
 Stratégie d’architecture pour le Canada et mise en œuvre de l’IA
 Définir la stratégie canadienne: Assumer la responsabilité de l’élaboration et de l’évolution de la stratégie d’architecture à l’échelle nationale, en créant des feuilles de route de modernisation pluriannuelles (de 3 à 5 ans), en collaboration avec le centre d’excellence (COE) dirigé par le chef de l’architecture au sein de notre pratique mondiale des technologies numériques, située aux États-Unis.
 Établir les feuilles de route fondamentales: Concevoir et mettre en œuvre une stratégie infonuagique et une stratégie de données complètes, adaptées aux besoins de nos activités canadiennes, afin de mettre les bases de la mise en œuvre d’une stratégie d’IA à l’échelle de l’entreprise.
 Assurer l’alignement avec les besoins de l’entreprise: Traduire les stratégies fonctionnelles et d’affaires en plans d’architecture opérationnels pour les principales plateformes d’entreprise (ERP, CRM, PLM, MES, gestion du cycle de vie des contrats, plateforme de données clients et systèmes connexes).
 Leadership matriciel et leadership éclairé
 Évoluer dans une structure matricielle: Travailler efficacement dans un environnement mondial hautement matriciel, en relevant directement du directeur exécutif des technologies numériques pour le Canada, tout en maintenant un lien hiérarchique matriciel étroit avec le chef de l’architecture aux États-Unis.
 Agir avec un fort sentiment d’urgence: Orienter les initiatives de transformation interfonctionnelles en veillant à ce que les besoins des activités canadiennes soient harmonisés avec l’orientation technologique mondiale à long terme de l’entreprise.
 Exercer une influence stratégique: Agir à titre de référence en matière d’architecture et conseiller la haute direction sur les décisions architecturales, les options d’investissement, les risques et les stratégies de transformation, en communiquant de manière claire et axée sur les enjeux d’affaires.
 Méthodologies, gouvernance et normes d’architecture
 Gouvernance: Définir, améliorer et mettre en œuvre les méthodologies, les normes et les modèles d’architecture d’entreprise afin d’assurer la cohérence, l’interopérabilité, la résilience des systèmes et une gestion efficace de leur cycle de vie, conformément aux normes américaines.
 Conformité: Contribuer aux processus du comité de révision de l’architecture (Architecture Review Board – ARB), notamment en matière de gouvernance de la sélection des technologies, des normes d’API, des modèles infonuagiques, des modèles de domaine et de la conformité architecturale.
 Approches architecturales modernes: API en priorité, architecture événementielle et infonuagique native
 Modernisation: Concevoir et promouvoir l’adoption d’approches privilégiant les API, d’architectures événementielles et de modèles infonuagiques natifs dans l’ensemble de l’organisation canadienne afin d’améliorer l’interopérabilité, la réutilisation des capacités, la rapidité d’intégration et la robustesse des systèmes.
 Architecture des données d’entreprise et développement sémantique et ontologique
 Des données au service de l’IA: Soutenir la stratégie d’architecture des données d’entreprise, notamment par le développement et l’utilisation d’ontologies, de modèles sémantiques, de graphes de connaissances et de structures de données normalisées. Ces éléments favorisent l’interopérabilité des données, la traçabilité de leur provenance, leur préparation à l’analytique et leur exploitation dans les initiatives d’IA à l’échelle de P&W Canada.
 Mentorat et développement de communautés de pratique
 Développer les talents: Diriger et accompagner les architectes afin de renforcer les capacités en architecture et de faire progresser la maturité architecturale au sein de l’organisation canadienne.
 Favoriser l’apprentissage collectif: Créer et diriger des communautés de pratique afin de favoriser le partage des connaissances, l’adoption de modèles modernes et l’harmonisation des pratiques architecturales entre les équipes.
 Participer au comité de révision de l’architecture: Être un membre actif du comité de révision de l’architecture dirigé par le directeur de l’architecture basé aux États-Unis.
 Résolution de problèmes interfonctionnels
 Résoudre des problèmes complexes: Résoudre des enjeux architecturaux complexes et non définis à l’échelle de l’entreprise, touchant à la fois les environnements existants et modernes, en s’appuyant sur des analyses approfondies, la recherche des causes fondamentales et l’évaluation de compromis multidimensionnels liés à la sécurité, à la performance, aux coûts, à la dette technique, aux risques et aux résultats d’affaires.
 Qu’est-ce qu’il vous faut pour réussir? 
 Baccalauréat en génie, en informatique, en technologies de l’information ou en systèmes d’information, et au moins 10 ans d’expérience en TI, dont 7 ans ou plus à titre d’architecte principal de solutions ou d’architecte d’entreprise; OU diplôme de cycle supérieur et au moins 7 ans d’expérience en TI, dont 6 ans ou plus en leadership en architecture.
 Expérience démontrée dans l’élaboration et la mise en œuvre de stratégies complètes en matière d’infonuagique, de données et d’IA à l’échelle nationale, régionale ou de l’entreprise.
 Capacité éprouvée à évoluer efficacement et à obtenir des résultats dans un environnement hiérarchique matriciel complexe impliquant des parties prenantes locales et mondiales, notamment aux États-Unis.
 Connaissance de l’ingénierie numérique et des technologies modernes fondées sur des modèles, notamment l’ingénierie des systèmes basée sur les modèles (MBSE), la conception basée sur les modèles (MBD), la définition, la fabrication et l’inspection basées sur les modèles (MBDMI), les services basés sur les modèles ainsi que la maintenance, la réparation et la révision (MRO).
 Expérience de la mise en œuvre de processus, de mécanismes de gouvernance et de normes d’architecture à l’échelle mondiale.
 Expertise approfondie des cadres d’architecture modernes, des conceptions infonuagiques natives ainsi que des modèles de livraison et d’exploitation axés sur les produits.
 Excellentes aptitudes en communication écrite et orale, avec la capacité de rédiger des communications d’affaires claires, concises et structurées logiquement, ainsi que de formuler des recommandations.
 Ce poste s’inscrit dans un milieu de travail francophone, néanmoins il nécessite une très bonne connaissance de l’anglais pour lire et comprendre, sur une base quotidienne, de la documentation et des termes techniques qui peuvent émaner d’organisations internationales, ainsi que pour écrire et communiquer en anglais avec des clients, des fournisseurs ou des collègues internationaux.
 Qualifications privilégiées 
 Approche méthodique de l’exécution et fort sentiment d’urgence dans la conduite des transformations technologiques.

 Excellentes aptitudes en présentation, tant dans des contextes formels qu’informels.

 Expertise démontrée en stratégie et en gouvernance des API, notamment une bonne compréhension des modèles architecturaux d’API, la capacité à définir des normes d’API et des cadres d’intégration à l’échelle de l’entreprise, ainsi que l’aptitude à en expliquer les avantages.

 About the Team: 
 Huawei Canada's Advanced Optical Technology Lab focuses on advanced R&D in high-performance optical communications and networking. Our expert team specializes in transmission algorithms, systems, physics, and optical network management. The lab engages in projects ranging from deep research to developing key product features, actively participating in standards organizations and collaborative research with partners. Our multicultural environment fosters innovation, mentorship, and a passion for learning. If you thrive on solving complex technical challenges, this lab is your ideal place. 
 About the Job: 
 You will bridge the gap between theoretical modeling and hands-on experimental validation to advance the next generation of optical fiber communication and sensing systems. 
 Your work will span the entire system lifecycle - from high-fidelity simulation and optimization to rigorous experimental testing, real-time performance monitoring, and advanced fault detection: 
 Design, build, and automate advanced optical laboratory testbeds to validate system-level performance. Conduct characterization of optical components (transceivers, amplifiers, fibers, and modulators). 
 Develop and maintain accurate numerical models of optical transmission systems, accounting for linear/nonlinear impairments (e.g., CD, PMD, SPM, XPM). System optimization for maximum capacity, reach, and efficiency. 
 Design and implement algorithms for real-time optical performance monitoring (OPM) and predictive fault detection to enhance network reliability and automated telemetry. 
 Explore and develop fiber-optic sensing capabilities (e.g., DAS, DTS, DSS) or utilize existing communication infrastructure for co-designed communication and sensing applications. 
 Analyze large datasets from experimental setups and field trials to root-cause anomalies, optimize system parameters, and close the loop between simulation and reality.

 Ph.D. in Photonics, Optical Communications, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a closely related field. 
 3+ years of post-Ph.D. or industry experience in optical fiber communication or sensing systems. 
 Strong hands-on laboratory skills. Deep familiarity with optical test equipment (e.g., Optical Spectrum Analyzers (OSAs), Real-Time Oscilloscopes, Bit Error Rate Testers (BERTs), Optical Time-Domain Reflectometers (OTDRs)). 
 Proficient in modeling optical wave propagation (e.g., solving the Nonlinear Schrödinger Equation). Strong programming skills in Python, MATLAB, or C++ for simulation, data analysis, and lab automation. 
 Solid understanding of coherent optical communication, advanced modulation formats (QAM, QPSK), digital signal processing (DSP) for optics, and fiber non-linearities.

 Knowledge of control systems for dynamic optical networks is an asset.

 À SP Canada, la vision qui nous inspire est celle d’un monde sans sclérose en plaques (SP). La SP est une maladie neurologique du système nerveux central (cerveau et moelle épinière), et le Canada affiche l’un des taux de SP les plus élevés du monde. Les personnes touchées par cette maladie se trouvent au cœur de notre travail. Notre mission consiste à mobiliser la collectivité de la SP en vue de la réalisation de progrès notables. Nous permettons aux membres de la collectivité de la SP d’accéder à des services de soutien essentiels, à de l’information sur la SP ainsi que sur les études qui sont en cours, et de tisser des liens avec d’autres personnes qui vivent avec cette affection. Nous collaborons avec des chercheurs et chercheuses, des donateurs et donatrices, des partenaires, des bénévoles, des personnes aux prises avec la SP, des proches aidants et aidantes et des professionnels et professionnelles de la santé afin de faire avancer les choses et d’optimiser l’impact de nos activités. Qu’il s’agisse d’améliorer maintenant la qualité de vie des gens de notre pays ou de financer des travaux de recherche de grande qualité dont les retombées permettront un jour d’éradiquer la SP, nous formons une communauté qui travaille à l’unisson – et vous pourriez faire partie de celle-ci.
 Notre équipe souhaite pourvoir un poste actuellement vacant de coordonnateur ou de coordonnatrice des solutions numériques. La personne choisie pourra provenir de n’importe quelle région du Canada. Elle travaillera selon un horaire hebdomadaire de 35 heures. Si ce poste vous intéresse, nous vous invitons à soumettre votre candidature d’ici au 24 novembre 2026. 
 Découvrir. Innover. Agir. 
 En vue de permettre un jour l’éradication de la SP, nous misons sur les découvertes, l’innovation et l’action collective. Cette stratégie vise à inciter les membres de la collectivité de la SP à s’unir en vue de l’atteinte d’un objectif commun : un monde sans SP. Ensemble, nous collaborons pour favoriser l’amélioration des traitements et des soins, le renforcement du bien-être, la compréhension et l’enrayement de la progression de la SP, et la prévention de cette maladie. 
 Si vous souhaitez en savoir plus sur SP Canada, sur l’impact de nos activités et sur ce qui fait de notre organisme un excellent milieu de travail, nous vous invitons à consulter notre site Web, à l’adresse spcanada.ca.
 Retombées qu’aura votre travail 
 La personne retenue contribuera au soutien relatif aux plateformes numériques, aux campagnes et aux outils qui permettent aux parties prenantes d’interagir avec SP Canada. En plus d’appuyer les activités, la compilation de statistiques et les projets en lien avec l’environnement numérique, cette personne s’assurera d’offrir une expérience numérique efficace et conviviale aux utilisateurs et utilisatrices, laquelle devra demeurer en harmonie avec les objectifs de l’organisme.
 Profil du candidat idéal ou de la candidate idéale 
 Qualifications requises : 
 Expérience de un à trois ans dans le domaine du soutien en lien avec des plateformes numériques, des sites Web, du marketing par courriel ou d’autres technologies numériques, ou une formation et des expériences pertinentes. 
 Expérience quant à l’utilisation du marketing numérique et d’outils de communication en ligne tels que salesforce Marketing Cloud, Campaign Monitor, de systèmes de gestion de contenu Web ou d’outils de création de formulaires en ligne. 
 Aptitudes marquées quant à l’analyse et à la résolution de problèmes, et capacité de compiler, d’interpréter et de présenter des données en lien avec la performance des outils numériques. 
 Très bon sens de l’organisation, aptitudes marquées quant à la communication et à la collaboration, et capacité à concilier de multiples priorités et à appuyer des projets interfonctionnels.
 Approche orientée vers le client, et engagement à offrir une expérience positive aux utilisateurs et utilisatrices et à procurer de la formation et du soutien de qualité à ceux-ci.
 Qualifications souhaitées : 
 Compétences confirmées avec Microsoft 365, y compris Teams et SharePoint, et aptitude à se familiariser rapidement avec de nouvelles technologies.
 Connaissance de base de HTML, CSS, SQL ou AMPscript. 
 Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral et à l’écrit, permettant d’appuyer les utilisateurs et utilisatrices d’un bout à l’autre du Canada – un atout.
 Ce que nous offrons 
 SP Canada offre aux membres de son personnel des possibilités de carrière déterminantes et gratifiantes ainsi qu’un programme complet d’avantages sociaux qui comprend notamment ce qui suit : 
 Un salaire initial qui se situe dans une fourchette allant de 50 000 $ à 53 520 $ par année.
 Un régime d’assurance concurrentiel pour soins médicaux et dentaires, des allocations de dépenses ainsi qu’une couverture pour affirmation de genre.
 La possibilité pour les membres du personnel d’assurer leur avenir financier grâce à un programme d’épargne retraite avec cotisation de l’employeur.
 Des investissements dans la croissance et le perfectionnement du personnel.
 Des conditions intéressantes en matière de congés rémunérés, y compris des vacances prolongées durant le temps des fêtes et la possibilité de prendre congé chaque vendredi après-midi précédant une longue fin de semaine.
 Des conditions de travail favorisant l’équilibre entre travail et vie personnelle grâce à des horaires souples et à des modalités de travail hybrides.
 Vous ne répondez pas à tous les critères? Des études démontrent que les personnes qui ne répondent pas à tous les critères sont peu susceptibles de soumettre leur candidature. Or, nous sommes déterminés à bâtir un milieu de travail inclusif, diversifié et authentique – si la présente offre d’emploi vous intéresse, mais que l’expérience que vous possédez ne correspond pas tout à fait à ce que nous cherchons, nous vous invitons à soumettre quand même votre candidature. Vous pourriez être la personne que nous cherchons pour ce poste ou pour d’autres. 
 Nous nous engageons à prendre des mesures d’accommodement tout au long du processus de recrutement pour répondre aux besoins des candidats et candidates. Veuillez signaler toute mesure d’adaptation dont vous pourriez avoir besoin. 
 Nous tenons à souligner que les lieux où nous travaillons et menons nos activités se trouvent sur le territoire traditionnel de nombreuses communautés métisses et inuites et communautés des Premières Nations. Nous reconnaissons et saluons la présence, les contributions et la résilience immuables des collectivités autochtones tout au long de l’histoire de notre pays. Nous sommes conscients de la responsabilité que nous avons de comprendre, de respecter et d’appuyer les nations autochtones du Canada ainsi que les relations indéfectibles de ces communautés avec la terre. 
 Dans le cadre de notre processus de recrutement, nous avons recours à des outils dotés de l’intelligence artificielle (IA) pour nous aider à résumer l’information qui concerne les candidats et candidates et à anonymiser les candidatures. Cela nous permet de réduire le risque de biais et de nous assurer d’offrir une expérience juste et cohérente à tous les candidats et candidates. À aucun moment l’IA ne déterminera les résultats du recrutement. Les décisions en matière de recrutement sont toujours prises par nos équipes d’embauche. 
 Veuillez noter que, conformément à notre politique relative aux mesures d’enquête pour les personnes en situation de confiance, un processus de vérification des antécédents fait partie des conditions d’emploi de SP Canada.

Fidus is a global high-tech design firm headquartered in Ottawa, with additional design centres in Kitchener-Waterloo and San Jose. We specialize in leading-edge electronic product development, with hardware, embedded software, FPGA/ASIC, and signal integrity teams working together to design and deliver next-generation products for clients in emerging technology markets.
 Position Overview/Mandate: 
 The FPGA Designer plays a key role in designing and delivering complex FPGA-based systems for Fidus clients. You will work directly with customers and internal Fidus teams to define architectures, implement RTL, integrate IP, run simulations, close timing, and support lab bring-up and debug.
 This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with new FPGA families and tools, is comfortable moving between different application domains (video, communications, storage, signal processing), and takes pride in producing high-quality, well-documented designs.
 Make an Impact with US: 
 At Fidus, you'll work on high-speed, high-complexity electronic systems, often using emerging technologies before they reach the broader market. You'll collaborate across FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical/thermal design as part of cross-functional teams delivering real products for our clients.
 In practice, that means contributing to projects across Communications, Aerospace & Defence, Life Sciences & Medical Devices, Space & Satellite, Industrial Automation, Automotive, and Semiconductor engagements. You won't be limited to a single product or industry—your work will follow the technology, not just one roadmap.
 What You’ll Be Doing: 
 Work with our clients and other Fidus Employees to develop complex FPGA and/or CPLD based systems, including architecture, custom development, integrated IP, simulations, and timing analysis and closure.
 Design FPGA based systems using Xilinx and Intel based devices and tools
 Participate in design reviews (hardware-software interface, input-outputs etc.) to ensure Fidus quality standards and customer requirements are being adhered to
 Perform lab testing, debug of prototypes and supporting hardware/software engineer, as needed
 Perform customer prototype demonstrations and author test plans, design description and user documentation
 Provide technical insight to customers during the pre-sales and implementation phase of projects
 Provide technical support to the Business Manager and Sales team by providing detailed estimates on project scope, schedule, and deliverables and to present the technical aspects of Fidus proposals to the client
 Who You are: 
 Minimum 5 years of experience designing using RTL/Verilog/VHDL on FPGAs.
 Experience with video systems and specification standards, video algorithms, and high-speed memory and bus interfaces, communications protocols, and DSP or processor instantiations.
 Created designs using Xilinx or Altera FPGA families and have a solid understanding of tool flow
 Experience with Verilog, SystemVerilog, VHDL, Xilinx Vivado, Altera Quartus, and/or ModelSim
 RTL design and verification including test benches, functional simulations, and timing closure
 Exhibit strong communication skills, are fluent in English, have great customer interaction presence, and quickly learn new technologies and processes
 Proven techniques and habits that lead to high quality design
 Embraces AI as part of a modern engineering toolkit
 Degree as a B.A.Sc., B.Eng. or equivalent
 As AMD Embedded Premier Partner, you will be certified to highest level of FPGA qualification – this will be your first “to-do” item upon joining us.
 Location and travel: Position is based in Canada. Travel may be required domestically and internationally to support customer engagements and project delivery.
 This position may require access to export-controlled information. Candidates will be required to complete background checks and security screening under Canada's Controlled Goods Program (CGP) and may also be required to obtain a security clearance under the Contract Security Program (CSP) administered by Public Services and Procurement Canada (PSPC, formerly PWGSC).

We are looking for experienced Senior Autonomous Vehicle Technicians to support the maintenance, diagnostics, repair, and operational readiness of autonomous vehicle fleets and robotaxi operations across North America.
As a Senior Autonomous Vehicle Technician, you will be responsible for ensuring that electric and autonomous vehicles remain safe, reliable, and ready for daily deployment. This role supports autonomous ride-hailing services, robotaxi fleet operations, on-road testing programs, and new city launches where vehicle uptime, technical precision, and safety compliance are critical.
You will work closely with AV Operations Leads, Depot Specialists, Safety Operators, SDS Specialists, engineering teams, and fleet operations teams to minimize vehicle downtime and keep the fleet operational. The role combines hands-on automotive repair, EV diagnostics, high-voltage safety, software updates, and support for autonomous driving hardware.
This position is ideal for an experienced automotive technician who wants to move into the future of mobility and work directly with electric vehicles, autonomous driving systems, ADAS technology, robotics, and self-driving vehicle platforms.

Key Responsibilities: Autonomous Vehicle Maintenance 
 Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on electric and autonomous vehicles used in robotaxi fleet operations .
 Ensure vehicles are technically ready for daily deployment, testing, commercial operations, and autonomous ride-hailing services .
 Conduct detailed vehicle inspections to support fleet readiness , vehicle uptime, and operational safety.
 Diagnose and repair mechanical, electrical, electronic, and software-related vehicle issues.
 Support maintenance workflows for high-availability autonomous vehicle fleets operating in shift-based or 24/7 environments.
 Advanced Diagnostics & Repair 
 Perform advanced diagnostics on EV platforms, ADAS systems, autonomous driving hardware, and vehicle electronic systems.
 Use OEM diagnostic tools, service software, and technical procedures to identify root causes of vehicle faults.
 Troubleshoot issues related to battery systems, drivetrains, braking systems, steering systems, sensors, cameras, wiring, and vehicle control modules.
 Replace, repair, and validate vehicle components according to safety, quality, and technical standards.
 Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams with clear documentation and diagnostic findings.
 EV & High-Voltage Systems 
 Work safely with electric vehicle systems , including high-voltage batteries, charging systems, inverters, and electric drivetrains.
 Follow strict high-voltage safety procedures when performing diagnostics, repairs, and component replacements.
 Support charging readiness and EV fleet availability in coordination with depot operations.
 Identify risks related to EV systems and escalate safety concerns immediately.

 Support installation, inspection, and replacement of autonomous vehicle hardware components.
 Assist with checks related to cameras, LiDAR, radar, compute units, wiring harnesses, sensor mounts, and related vehicle systems.
 Coordinate with SDS Specialists when issues involve the self-driving system , sensor calibration, or autonomous driving software.
 Ensure autonomous driving hardware remains properly installed, clean, functional, and ready for operation.

 Support post-repair testing to confirm vehicle functionality before returning the vehicle to robotaxi operations .
 Verify that repairs and maintenance actions do not impact vehicle safety, operational readiness, or autonomous system performance.
 Maintain accurate service records, diagnostic reports, and repair documentation.

 Act as the technical lead during assigned shifts when required.
 Provide guidance and escalation support to junior technicians, depot teams, and fleet operations staff.
 Support training of new technicians on vehicle maintenance procedures, safety standards, and operational workflows.
 Collaborate with Operations Leads to prioritize vehicle repairs and reduce fleet downtime.
 Operational Excellence

 Support continuous improvement initiatives related to fleet maintenance , depot operations , and autonomous vehicle deployment .

 OEM certification or dealership experience with EV or premium vehicle platforms.

The Requirements Management Lead is responsible for establishing and maintaining the complete requirements framework for the LRT program, ensuring traceability from concept design through testing, commissioning, and operations. This role ensures that all project requirements—technical, functional, operational, safety, and regulatory—are captured, verified, and validated in alignment with systems engineering principles and client objectives. The Requirements Management Lead acts as the single point of accountability for requirements configuration control, change management, and compliance demonstration across all project disciplines.
 Develop and implement the Requirements Management Plan (RMP) defining processes, tools, roles, and interfaces for managing requirements throughout the project lifecycle.
 Establish and maintain the Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) linking high-level project objectives to design outputs, verification evidence, and acceptance criteria.
 Ensure all requirements are structured, measurable, and verifiable, aligned with EN 50126/50128/50129 systems assurance standards.
 Coordinate with Systems Lead, Interface Manager, and Integration Manager to ensure consistent requirement flow down to subsystems (Rolling Stock, Signaling/TSP, OCS/TPSS, Telecom/SCADA, Fare System, OMSF).
 Facilitate requirements capture workshops with stakeholders to translate operational needs into technical and functional specifications.
 Govern configuration control and change management for requirements baselines in coordination with the Configuration Manager.
 Monitor contractor compliance with requirements and verification plans; track status and deviations.
 Review and approve requirements management deliverables from design consultants and contractors.
 Ensure verification and validation (V&V) activities are linked to requirements and that all evidence is properly documented and auditable.
 Support the Safety and RAMS teams in tracing safety and performance requirements through the Safety Case and certification process.
 Develop dashboards and reporting mechanisms to track requirement completion, V&V status, and compliance performance.
 Provide training and mentorship to PMC and client teams on requirements management processes and tool usage.
 Lead readiness reviews, audits, and regulatory submissions to demonstrate compliance and system assurance.
 Coordinate with Integration and Testing teams to ensure validation test cases fully satisfy operational requirements.
 Maintain a controlled database of all project requirements and verification evidence.
Required 
 Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
 12-18 years of experience in requirements management and systems engineering within major rail or transit infrastructure programs.
 Demonstrated expertise in requirements lifecycle management across design, testing, commissioning, and operational phases.
 Strong knowledge of systems engineering processes and the V-model lifecycle in accordance with EN 50126.
 Experience applying EN 50126, EN 50128, and EN 50129 standards within complex infrastructure environments.
 Expertise with requirements management platforms including IBM DOORS, Jama Connect, or Polarion.
 Proven capability establishing and maintaining end-to-end requirements traceability across multidisciplinary engineering teams.
 Extensive experience with Verification and Validation (V&V) methodologies, compliance assessments, and audit activities.
 Knowledge of safety assurance and RAMS frameworks and their integration with project requirements.
 Strong configuration management, baseline control, analytical, and technical documentation skills.
 Ability to interpret complex engineering documentation and develop structured, traceable requirements.
 Excellent stakeholder coordination, communication, and technical leadership capabilities.
 Assets 
 Master's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline.
 Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation.
 INCOSE ASEP or INCOSE CSEP certification.
 Experience supporting rail system certification and regulatory approval processes.
 Prior leadership responsibility for mentoring systems engineering or requirements management teams.
 Experience delivering requirements governance within large-scale multidisciplinary program management environments.

A profitable DTC pet brand is looking for a Head of Retention & Customer Experience to join our team! You will own everything after the first order: subscriptions, email and SMS, the post-purchase journey and customer experience, across both of our brands.
 We're doing $50M+ a year and scaling to $100M+, and we want one senior leader who owns retention A-Z: lower churn, significantly higher lifetime value and a better customer experience across the board. We are looking to hire someone with 5-6+ years in retention or lifecycle at DTC brands, who has led retention at a subscription brand doing $30-50M+ a year (ideally nine figures). The ideal candidate is hands-on in Klaviyo and Loop (or similar), has led a retention and customer experience team, and has managed agencies.
 The mission of this role 
 Own retention A-Z to fuel the growth to 9-figures. This role comes in to drive three things: lower churn, significantly higher lifetime value, and a better customer experience across the board. Success is lower churn, stronger retention, much higher lifetime value, more revenue from email and SMS, and happier customers.
 Who are we? 
 We are a profitable DTC brand selling premium pet products. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched a second brand, expanding into a new customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.
 What is our culture like & who is a good fit? 
 Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:
 Better Everyday: have a retention test live every week across subscriptions, flows or the post-purchase experience, and write down what each result teaches.
 Speed Is King: spot a churn, refund or CSAT problem the day it shows up and have a fix in motion that week.
 Work Smart: AI and automation first. Claude reads cancellation reasons, reviews and tickets to find why customers leave, AI drafts flow copy and segments, and retention KPIs report themselves every week.
 Overdeliver: bring the CEO the next big retention lever before being asked, and get more lifetime value from every customer than the plan called for.
 If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it. 
 If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place.
 Outcomes (what success looks like) 
 90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.
 Churn goes down: monthly subscription churn and save rate, by brand
 Retention improves: repeat purchase rate and cohort retention at 3, 6 and 12 months
 Lifetime value rises significantly: 12-month lifetime value by cohort and brand vs the same cohorts last year
 Email and SMS drive more revenue: email and SMS share of total revenue, and revenue per recipient
 Customers are happier across the board: CSAT, review rating, refund rate and tickets per order
 Key Objectives 
 Own the subscription program for both brands: offers, cadence, bundles, the customer portal and the cancellation flow.
 Build and test save offers, skip, swap and pause options, and win-back flows to cut churn.
 Own email and SMS strategy for both brands, and manage the retention agency's calendar, flows, targets and results.
 Build the lifecycle journey from first order to loyal customer: welcome, post-purchase, replenishment, cross-sell, win-back and VIP flows.
 Map and improve the full post-purchase journey, and run a loyalty, referral or VIP program if the numbers support it.
 Lead the customer experience team and set customer service policy that protects both the customer and the margin.
 Report cohort retention and lifetime value against target every month, and name the biggest lever.
 Fully remote, based outside the US.
 Fluent in English.
 Retention Leadership: 5-6+ years in retention or lifecycle at DTC brands, including leading retention at a subscription brand doing $30-50M+ a year (ideally nine figures). This is a must.
 Subscription Expertise: you have grown a subscription program and know churn, saves, cohorts and MRR inside out.
 Lifecycle Marketing: you build email and SMS programs (Klaviyo or similar) that drive a large share of revenue without burning the list.
 Tools: deep hands-on experience with Klaviyo (or similar) and Loop (or a similar subscription platform).
 Analytical: you read cohort, lifetime value and churn data fast and find the lever that moves the number.
 Testing Discipline: you run clear tests on offers, flows and save tactics, and read results honestly.
 Leadership: you have led a retention and customer experience team, including managing agencies, through KPIs and goals.
 Commercial Judgement: you protect margin, and know when a discount or save offer earns its cost.
 Customer obsessed: you understand why customers stay or leave, and fix the cause, not the symptom.
 Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
 Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder.
 Accountabilities 
 What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week.
 Subscriptions and churn: own the subscription program for both brands, keep at least one save or retention test live every week, grow the share of new customers who subscribe (working with the CRO Lead on on-site and post-purchase offers), and report subscribers, MRR, churn and save rate by brand every week.
 Email, SMS and lifecycle: own email and SMS strategy, manage the retention agency, keep the calendar live and flows in testing, keep list health and deliverability strong, and plan sale and launch campaigns with the Head of Growth and the Head of Brand & Community.
 Post-purchase experience and loyalty: ship at least one post-purchase improvement every month, and use cancellation reasons, reviews, surveys and support contact reasons to find why customers leave and fix the cause with the owning team.
 Customer experience and support: lead the Customer Experience Manager, own the weekly CX KPI scorecard (CSAT, first response time, AI resolution rate, refund rate and chargebacks), set customer service policy, and grow 4- and 5-star reviews.
 Retention data and reporting: track cohort retention, repeat purchase rate and lifetime value by brand and channel, report retention KPIs weekly, run a monthly retention review with the CEO, and write the retention playbook as SOPs so it runs without one person.
 How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate 
 (1) Application + Screening Interview
 (2) In-Depth Interview with our CEO
 (3) Reference Calls
 (4) Final Interview with our CEO
 Salary Expectation 
 USD $115,000 to $145,000 a year (based on experience and expertise) + performance bonus of 15-20% of base after the trial period.

 We are hiring someone to own recruiting for the leaders and talent who will help grow Manos and our businesses.
 Your searches will include Managing Directors, General Managers, CTOs, M&A Associates, and candidates for our Managing Director Track. This program brings MBA graduates and early career leaders into a business, with the opportunity to become a General Manager within 12 to 24 months, depending on their progress and the needs of the group.
 We expect approximately twelve searches a year. Every appointment matters. You will need to understand the need, find the right people, and build the evidence required to make a sound decision.
 You will report to the Investment Partner responsible for operations and work with our business leaders and the partner responsible for acquisitions. You will personally run searches and build a common assessment method across the group, adapted to the requirements of each role.

 • Uphold the hiring standard. Make recommendations grounded in evidence, explain uncertainties, and challenge decisions that are not sufficiently supported. Escalate disagreements to the responsible Investment Partner.
 • Help leaders become better at hiring. Coach them to define their needs, conduct stronger interviews, and compare candidates using relevant criteria.
 • Learn from hiring outcomes. Revisit assessments with managers after people join. Understand what you predicted correctly and what you missed, then improve the method.
 What we look for 
 • Sound judgment and the ability to analyze a problem, ask precise questions, and reach conclusions with incomplete information.
 • Curiosity about businesses, their customers, how they operate, and how they produce results.
 • The ability to engage people who are difficult to reach and earn their interest.
 • Independence in defending your assessment and openness to changing your view when the evidence changes.
 • Demonstrated ownership, persistence, and rigorous follow through.
 • Fluency in French and English, written and spoken, to work with candidates and leaders in Quebec and across North America.
 • Discretion when handling searches and candidate information.
 Experience in recruiting or executive search is valuable, but it is not required. We welcome backgrounds in operations, consulting, investing, and entrepreneurship. We will look for evidence of your judgment, ability to learn, and accomplishments.
 Why Manos 
 You will work directly with the people investing in and running our businesses. You will build a recruiting and assessment method used across several companies while personally leading important searches.
 Success means hiring strong people, improving the quality of our decisions, and helping our leaders become better at hiring.

 Dropbox is hiring an Integrated Campaign Strategist to architect and orchestrate marketing campaigns for priority product launches and evergreen marketing motions. This role turns business priorities, audience insight, and product positioning into a clear campaign strategy that defines the audience, narrative, journey, channel roles, activation sequence, and measurement plan. 
 Y ou will be the steward of how these campaigns show up in market across owned, earned, and paid channels. Working across Product Marketing, Brand and Creative, C omms , Web, Lifecycle, Paid Media, Content, Events, Marketing Operations, Analytics, and Sales, you will align teams around one integrated plan, connect individual activations into a coherent enterprise buyer experience, and guide the campaign from brief through launch, optimization, and learning. 
 This is a senior individual contributor role for a strategist who can lead through influence, make tradeoffs in ambiguity, and balance strong market storytelling with measurable business impact. You will help Dropbox bring important product stories to enterprise audiences with greater consistency, relevance, and effectiveness. 
 Responsibilities 
 Campaign strategy architecture: Translate mid-market and enterprise business goals, product positioning, audience insight, and market context into integrated campaign strategies for key launches and evergreen motions, including objectives, audience, narrative, journey, channel roles, phasing, and measurement. 
 Cross channel orchestration: Build and manage the integrated activation plan across owned, earned, and paid channels so that w eb, lifecycle, content, social, communications, events, partner, and media programs work as one connected campaign rather than separate channel plans. 
 In - market stewardship: Own the campaign through launch and sustainment, protecting the strategic throughline while ensuring creative, messaging, timing, and audience experience remain coherent across touchpoints and regions. 
 Cross - functional leadership: Establish the brief, operating rhythm, decision rights, milestones, dependencies, and readiness criteria that align Product Marketing, Brand and Creative, Communications, channel owners, Marketing Operations, Marketing Data Science , regional partners, and Sales.

Job Description Summary 
English Below
Nous recherchons un ingénieur principal, données de produits, pour concevoir et optimiser les systèmes numériques régissant nos disjoncteurs haute tension conçus sur commande (ETO). Ce rôle se situe à l'intersection de la structure mécanique des produits et de l'ingénierie des données. Vous devrez traduire des logiques d'ingénierie complexes en systèmes de configuration évolutifs et automatisés. Vous serez responsable de l'intégrité du flux de données, de la définition de l'ingénierie jusqu'à l'exécution de la fabrication au sein de SAP.
************************************************************************
We are seeking a Lead Product Data Engineer to drive the evolution of our digital product configuration and data systems for engineered-to-order (ETO) High Voltage Circuit Breaker products. This role blends mechanical product knowledge with data engineering expertise to build and maintain robust, scalable systems for managing product structure, configuration rules, and manufacturing readiness. 
As the technical lead for our product configurator and product data infrastructure, you will own the flow of information from engineering definition to manufacturing execution, ensuring accuracy, traceability, and usability across platforms—including our SAP ERP system. This is a hands-on role with strategic influence, perfect for someone ready to lead initiatives without direct people management responsibilities. 
 Job Description 
 Rôles & Responsabilités 
 English Below 
 Responsabilités techniques 
 Gestion de plateforme : Agir en tant que responsable principal de la plateforme de configuration de produits (Genesis). Traduire les contraintes mécaniques et les variantes de produits en une logique structurée et sans erreur.
 Ingénierie des données : Concevoir et déployer des pipelines de données automatisés. Développer des scripts et des outils pour maintenir l'intégrité des données entre le configurateur et les outils SAP/d'entreprise.
 Architecture des nomenclatures (BOM) : Superviser l'intégrité structurelle des nomenclatures de fabrication. Assurer le contrôle des versions, la traçabilité et la conformité à la production.
 Automatisation des processus : Créer des outils de validation et des tableaux de bord pour surveiller l'utilisation de la configuration, identifier les goulots d'étranglement de la complexité des produits et automatiser les flux de données.
 Gouvernance : Définir l'architecture technique des données produits. Agir à titre d'expert-conseil sur la logique de configuration, assurant l'évolutivité et la cohérence des systèmes à long terme.
 Qualifications techniques 
 Expertise du domaine : Minimum 3 ans d'expérience dans des environnements ETO; compréhension approfondie des structures de produits mécaniques et des hiérarchies de nomenclatures.
 Maîtrise des systèmes : Expérience démontrée dans la gestion des nomenclatures, des fiches articles et des données de production dans SAP.
 Compétences en développement : Maîtrise avancée de SQL et Python pour la manipulation de données, l'automatisation et le développement de pipelines.
 Logique de configuration : Expérience avec des plateformes de configuration formelles (ex. : Tacton, Configure One, Salesforce CPQ).
 Leadership technique : Capacité démontrée à gérer des initiatives techniques complexes impliquant plusieurs parties prenantes, sans gestion directe de personnel requise.
   Expérience technique souhaitée 
 Intégration de systèmes PLM et interaction avec les données CAO.
 Orchestration de données (ex. : dbt, Airflow) ou environnements infonuagiques (AWS/Azure).
 Outils de visualisation de données et d'informatique décisionnelle (ex. : Power BI, Tableau).
 Enjeux du poste 
 Ce rôle est destiné à un ingénieur (ou diplômé en ingénierie ou équivalent) qui valorise la précision et les systèmes à fort impact. Vous serez responsable de :
 Combler l'écart : Résoudre la déconnexion entre l'intention d'ingénierie et la capacité de fabrication.
 Résolution logique : Convertir l'ambiguïté des exigences produits en règles de configuration rigides et répétables.
 Intégrité système : Garantir que, à mesure que la complexité de nos produits augmente, notre infrastructure de données demeure robuste et traçable.
 *****************************************************************************
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own and maintain the product configurator (AC1) platform, translating engineering logic and product structure into accurate, user-friendly configuration rules. 
 Develop and manage data pipelines to support the flow of configuration data into SAP & potentially other engineering design tools.  
 Set up and manage production Bills of Materials (BOMs) in SAP , ensuring accurate, version-controlled, and production-ready product structures. 
 Partner with design engineering teams to interpret and digitize mechanical rules, constraints, and variants into structured configuration logic. 
 Build tools, scripts, and dashboards for data validation, automation, and reporting on configuration usage and product complexity. 
 Support integration of the configurator with other enterprise tools to ensure seamless data flow and traceability across the product lifecycle.  
 Act as the subject matter expert for product data architecture and governance , ensuring scalability and consistency. 
 Collaborate with manufacturing and supply chain teams to validate BOMs and ensure manufacturability of configured outputs. 
 Qualifications   Required: 
 Minimum 3 years of experience in engineering, data engineering, or configuration/data systems roles. 
 Strong understanding of mechanical products, BOMs, and product structure in an ETO (engineered to order) environment.

 Overview 
 Sunlife Health brings together the scale of a mature group benefits business with the pace and innovation of digital health. The Sunlife Health Strategy team focuses on the questions that shape what comes next: where to play, what to build, and how to grow.
 As Senior Consultant, you'll take an ambiguous strategic question, turn it into a clear plan of attack, find the answer, and engage senior leaders and decision makers to deliver results. Additionally, you will run the monthly strategy reporting cycle to monitor progress of our biggest priorities and distribute updates directly to the Health leadership team, and ultimately to the President of Sunlife Canada. You'll report to the Director, Strategy, who will act as your coach and thought partner, and work closely with peers across Sunlife Health teams.
 What will you do? 
 Planning and sharing strategy : You’ll help shape and communicate the overall Sunlife Health strategy at key points during the annual planning cycle. This includes:
 Preparing materials that frame strategic discussions and decisions at leadership offsites
 Developing executive-ready strategy content for presentation to the CEO and the Board
 Building town hall and team materials to cascade the strategy to employees at every level
 Leading strategy work: Most of your time goes into the strategic questions that shape our business. You’ll take each from a vague question to a recommendation leaders act on.
 Frame the problem. Work out what the real question is, then break a complex or vague problem into specific, answerable questions and testable hypotheses.
 Find the evidence. Plan how to answer each question. Gather research and data, judge which sources are credible, and build analyses in Excel with sound statistical basics.
 Find the insight. Separate insight from information. When you see a gap or a pattern, dig until you understand it.
 Bring stakeholders along. Build trusted relationships with leaders and partners across the business. Learn what each one needs, involve them early, and keep them informed.
 Make the case. Write concise, structured documents and slides for executive readers, and present them with confidence.
 Run the work. Plan and deliver workstreams on time, and keep your leaders and stakeholders updated on progress without being asked.
 Running the monthly strategy reporting cycle: For the second week of each month, you'll make sure the President of Sunlife Canada sees an accurate, clear picture of how each strategic initiative is tracking.
 Collect   and check metrics for each strategic initiative from metric owners across teams, ensuring accuracy such that figures line up across reports and time periods.
 Find the insight. Look independently at everything at your disposal to spot patterns, risks, and what's driving them.
 Get the story.  When a metric is off track, ask the owner why and how it will recover, offering problem-solving support and refining commentary for clarity and brevity.
 Send  concise, scannable review emails to Vice Presidents and the Senior Vice President, ahead of the report reaching the President.
 Each quarter, you'll also prepare briefing notes that give deeper insight into the areas they care most about. From time to time, expect ad hoc requests, such as adding new metrics or gathering leaders' candid view of where the year will end.

 By month 3: You own a strategy workstream, have delivered a recommendation that helps a senior leader make a decision, and you’ve co-run three monthly reporting cycles

 3+ years of experience in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, or another analytical, problem-solving role

 North America is one of our fastest-growing markets, and we are investing in senior delivery leadership to match that growth. As the portfolio has scaled, we want dedicated, senior ownership of delivery so that specialist talent across the region is deployed where it adds the most value, and so delivery has a clear, accountable leader who can bring order and pace to a growing and increasingly complex portfolio.
 You will be a key delivery partner to our EVP, Technology - North America. This is a hands-on leadership role, not a governance or process role sitting apart from the work. You will take direct ownership of the delivery portfolio, freeing up senior leadership time to focus on regional strategy, team growth and client relationships, while you own how delivery runs day to day.
 This role also means operating as a business partner to Product and Go-To-Market leadership — working through delivery, resourcing and prioritization decisions together with those teams from the outset, rather than receiving requirements after the fact.

 Delivery Leadership & Ownership 
 •      Take direct, senior ownership of the North America technology delivery portfolio — not oversight from a distance, but hands-on accountability for how delivery actually runs.

 •      Build genuine business-partner relationships with Product and Go-To-Market leadership, working through resourcing, prioritization and delivery trade-offs collaboratively and end-to-end rather than as a downstream function.

 Resource Management, Tooling & Commercial Visibility 
 •      Establish clear, consistent approaches to resource planning, capacity management and utilization across North America.
 •      Ensure delivery teams use agreed tools and processes to track time and effort accurately, creating real visibility into who is working on what, where and when.
 •      Partner with commercial and finance colleagues to ensure delivery data supports margin management, forecasting and Statements of Work.
 •      Use delivery and resourcing insight proactively to identify risk early and drive corrective action before it escalates.
 Cross-Regional Partnership

 •      Bring proven approaches from other regions into North America to accelerate delivery maturity, and feed North America's own learning back into the global model.
 People & Leadership
